text:
carmen: Quick flag 1 trial onboarding delay cluster detected between 2026-09-02 02:00Z and 2026-09-02 04:30Z affecting ~16 trials. Drafting outbound note + credits. Need input on compensation and whether to proactively schedule 1:1s for high-touch.

leo: How bad were the delays? Any customers still blocked?

carmen: Peak delays ~3 hours for some tenants; most recovered after replay. Two high-touch customers (OrbitWorks, BeaconLab) temporarily lacked embeddings/indexes until we re-ingested. Full list: https://redwood.internal/cs/impacted_0902 (internal).

viv: Infra short RCA: an S3 regional read throttle + a transient client-side retry bug caused ingestion jobs to backlog and stall index creation. We deployed a fix that adds exponential jitter and parallelizes small-object downloads; reingest is in progress. Fix deployed 2026-09-02T05:10Z.

ops-bot: deploy: hotfix/2026-09-02-s3-ingest-jitter deployed by @viv at 2026-09-02T05:10Z :white_check_mark:

carmen: Can someone draft a 1-2 sentence customer-facing RCA (non-technical) I can paste into the email? Also confirm credit suggestion—thinking 25% for next month for trials that experienced >2h of delay.

viv: Customer RCA draft: "We encountered a temporary delay while ingesting initial data for a subset of trial accounts due to an external storage service throttling event. Our team fixed the ingestion pipeline, re-processed affected data, and confirmed those accounts are now available. Were adding safeguards to reduce the chance of this reoccurring and apologize for the disruption."

leo: 25% credit sounds fair. Also offer a 30-min 1:1 for OrbitWorks and BeaconLab and proactively loop their AEs.

billing: Confirmed we can apply a one-time 25% credit to the next billing cycle for qualifying trials; need the impacted list with timestamps to compute eligibility.

ae_maya: I'll ping OrbitWorks/BeaconLab AEs now and offer the 1:1s. Please include an optional migration checklist in the invite so we can triage live.

carmen: Action items: viv 1 post final replay completion time here; billing 1 accept the impacted CSV and process credits; ae_maya 1 AE outreach and schedule 1:1s for the two high-touch; leo 1 finalize email copy with the RCA + credit mechanics by EOD.

viv: Reingest at ~65% now, ETA ~50 minutes. Will post final confirmation when done.

carmen: If reingest slips beyond 2h ETA we offer an extended credit window and a follow-up remediation call with an engineer. Thank you all.
